title: OpenRTB 2.6 BidRequest
description: Top-level bid request object containing an exchange unique bid request or auction ID.

id.description: ID of the bid request, assigned by the exchange, and unique for the exchange's subsequent tracking of the responses.

imp.description: Array of Imp objects representing the impressions offered. At least 1 Imp object is required.

site.description: Details about the publisher's website. Only applicable and recommended for websites.

app.description: Details about the publisher's app (non-browser applications). Only applicable and recommended for apps.

dooh.description: This object should be included if the ad supported content is a Digital Out-Of-Home screen.

device.description: Details about the user's device to which the impression will be delivered.

user.description: Details about the human user of the device; the advertising audience.

test.description: Indicator of test mode in which auctions are not billable, where 0 = live mode, 1 = test mode.

at.description: Auction type, where 1 = First Price, 2 = Second Price Plus. Exchange-specific auction types can be defined using values 500 and greater.

tmax.description: Maximum time in milliseconds the exchange allows for bids to be received including Internet latency to avoid timeout.

wseat.description: Allowed list of buyer seats allowed to bid on this impression.

bseat.description: Block list of buyer seats restricted from bidding on this impression.

allimps.description: Flag to indicate if Exchange can verify that the impressions offered represent all of the impressions available in context. 0 = no or unknown, 1 = yes.

cur.description: Array of allowed currencies for bids on this bid request using ISO-4217 alpha codes.

wlang.description: Allowed list of languages for creatives using ISO-639-1-alpha-2.

wlangb.description: Allowed list of languages for creatives using IETF BCP 47.

acat.description: Allowed advertiser categories using the specified category taxonomy.

bcat.description: Blocked advertiser categories using the specified category taxonomy.

cattax.description: The taxonomy in use for bcat/acat. Refer to the AdCOM 1.0 list: Category Taxonomies.

badv.description: Block list of advertisers by their domains (e.g., "ford.com").

bapp.description: Block list of applications by their app store IDs.

source.description: A Source object that provides data about the inventory source and which entity makes the final decision.

regs.description: A Regs object that specifies any industry, legal, or governmental regulations in force for this request.

ext.description: Placeholder for exchange-specific extensions to OpenRTB.
